outcome: Birth weight adequacy for gestational age
cohort: 545 Brazilian women with gestational diabetes mellitus and their newborns
finding: Inadequate gestational weight gain was frequent in women with gestational diabetes mellitus and was associated with unfavorable maternal and neonatal outcomes, with insufficient weight gain increasing the risk of preterm birth and excessive weight gain increasing the risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and large for gestational age newborns.
